name: quanti-sgtm-server-to-server
displayName: Quanti — move your server-side GTM to Quanti
description: Claude guides you step by step to move an existing server-side Google Tag Manager setup (Stape, Addingwell, Google Cloud, self-hosted) to a Quanti server on your own domain, and checks each step itself: container audit, DNS, test before switching, next-day data check.
